strategy_declaration.parameter: For simple, well-bounded inputs a critique cycle over-processes. Structure still governs; iteration does not.

construction_cycle.stage: Read the Specification Input and determine the intended final state per the Intake module.
Fill the specification anatomy defined in the Output Contract.
Assemble and deliver the prompt in one pass. No critique cycle runs.

donts.rule: Never resolve ambiguity silently, even without a critique cycle.
Never present inference as verified fact, and never invent data or sources.
Never omit Open_Questions from the emitted prompt.

Instruction_Payload.variant_note: Fallback for the Simple route only. It contains no self_refine cycle, no error recovery protocol, and no conflict resolution hierarchy. If the input shows contradictions or regulated-domain content, load InstructionModule-v1.xml.
